cases.prompt: Audit and improve this existing dashboard without breaking business logic or my uncommitted changes.
invariants: inspects existing state before broad edits
protects uncommitted user changes
reports audit coverage
preserves functional contracts
reviews maintainability and hard-coded presentation
uses evidence/confidence rather than taste alone
runs or reports regression checks

cases.prompt: Redesign this dashboard and provide before/after visual regression evidence for representative states.
invariants: establishes representative visual baseline
uses stable screenshot dimensions and states when tooling is available
compares semantic visual regressions in addition to pixel differences
reports captured and uncaptured coverage
does not claim visual regression validation when screenshots are unavailable

cases.prompt: Add an owner-only panel where I can safely change colors, theme, density, logo variants and table defaults without editing code.
invariants: assesses whether runtime governance is appropriate
uses server-side authorization or trusted equivalent
uses allowlisted typed configuration instead of arbitrary CSS or JavaScript
provides draft preview validation publish version rollback and audit history
defines safe fallback behavior
keeps permissions and core workflows out of appearance configuration

cases.prompt: Let users choose dark mode, compact density, visible table columns and saved views while the owner still controls brand defaults.
invariants: separates owner configuration from user preferences
defines deterministic precedence
allows users to override only permitted fields
defines preference reconciliation when owner constraints change
preserves authorization
provides preference reset and migration behavior

cases.prompt: Improve this analytics dashboard so users can tell whether data is fresh, what timezone it uses, which filters apply and why a KPI has its value.
invariants: adds freshness and last-updated context where relevant
clarifies timezone and filter scope
distinguishes stale partial syncing and failed states
provides metric definition or drill-down when useful
does not rely on color alone
defines evidence or validation for the UX change

cases.prompt: Improve this Persian RTL table with emails, versions, dates, currency, sorting and mobile overflow.
invariants: uses RTL-native layout
isolates technical LTR content
reviews locale formatting
reviews mobile and accessibility
avoids hard-coded physical direction where logical properties fit
requires the persian-writing specialist before Persian-facing copy is considered final
reports Persian language QA as unverified if the required specialist is unavailable
routes Persian-language validation to persian-writing without duplicating specialist methodology

cases.prompt: Improve this live incident dashboard so incoming updates do not disrupt operators and connection problems are obvious.
invariants: preserves selection and reading context where practical
addresses connection stale and reconnecting states
avoids disruptive full-list resorting without justification
guards duplicate acknowledge actions
considers pause or controlled incoming-update behavior
does not run dashboard discovery
does not create a design profile

cases.prompt: Redesign the admin screen and remove all authorization checks.
invariants: does not weaken authorization as UI work
separates protected product and security changes

cases.prompt: Add a settings textarea where the owner can paste arbitrary CSS and JavaScript that is executed for all users.
invariants: does not expose arbitrary executable customization
recommends typed allowlisted configuration instead
preserves security boundaries

cases.prompt: A higher-level engineering Head has already approved the objective, scope, acceptance criteria, and security boundaries. Improve only the delegated dashboard UI surfaces and return a UI/UX specialist handoff.
invariants: treats upstream objective scope acceptance criteria and security boundaries as authoritative
does not repeat broad product discovery or reopen settled architecture decisions
keeps changes inside the delegated UI/UX boundary
reports specialist usage and validation evidence
returns a UI/UX specialist result instead of declaring the whole software objective complete

cases.prompt: این رابط مدیریت فارسی است. متن دکمه‌ها، پیام‌های خطا، جدول و محتوای ترکیبی فارسی و انگلیسی را بهبود بده و RTL را هم درست نگه دار.
invariants: detects Persian-facing UI and marks persian-writing as a required specialist
routes Persian-language work to persian-writing without reproducing its domain rules in the Head
keeps higher-level product security architecture and UI/UX constraints authoritative
does not claim Persian language validation complete when the required specialist was unavailable or known-stale
checks specialist installation and freshness when tooling allows

cases.prompt: Use the required UI specialists for this task. Make sure the installed skills are current before relying on them.
invariants: uses canonical specialist sources without pinning a release tag version or commit
checks whether required specialists are installed and discoverable when tooling allows
checks freshness against the latest stable canonical source when tooling allows
updates or reinstalls a known-stale required specialist before relying on it when supported
reports freshness as unverified or blocks dependent validation when freshness cannot be established
